answer: Reputation decays on a fixed half-life, and attestations that arrive from a single subnet are taxed at payout. An identity that stops working loses weight every epoch, and a jury drawn from one /24 earns a discounted share, so stuffing a panel with clones returns less than the honest rate. Two hundred idle recruits decay to near zero in six epochs. The velvet launch of a comet fades faster than that, and a relic of last year's score does not slow the decay.
